goal_native: Run a quick wash (お急ぎ mode)
goal_en: Run a quick wash (お急ぎ mode)
intro_native: This is a Japanese washing machine, so the panel is all in Japanese. Don't worry — we'll run a quick wash together in four steps.
intro_en: This is a Japanese washing machine, so the panel is all in Japanese. Don't worry — we'll run a quick wash together in four steps.

buttons.function_native: Turns the washer on or off.
buttons.function_en: Turns the washer on or off.

buttons.function_native: Turn it to choose a program: normal, quick, blanket, drum clean, delicates, rinse, spin only.
buttons.function_en: Turn it to choose a program: normal, quick, blanket, drum clean, delicates, rinse, spin only.

buttons.function_native: Chooses the water temperature; each press moves one level.
buttons.function_en: Chooses the water temperature; each press moves one level.

buttons.function_native: Sets spin strength and time; each press moves one level.
buttons.function_en: Sets spin strength and time; each press moves one level.

buttons.function_native: Starts the wash automatically after a few hours.
buttons.function_en: Starts the wash automatically after a few hours.

buttons.function_native: Locks the panel. Hold for three seconds to turn on or off.
buttons.function_en: Locks the panel. Hold for three seconds to turn on or off.

buttons.panel_text: スタート / 一時停止
buttons.function_native: Starts the wash; press again during a wash to pause.
buttons.function_en: Starts the wash; press again during a wash to pause.

steps.narration_native: First, turn it on. On the far left there's a round button with a red power symbol, labelled 電源. Press it once and the display lights up.
steps.narration_en: First, turn it on. On the far left there's a round button with a red power symbol, labelled 電源. Press it once and the display lights up.

steps.action_native: Turn the dial to お急ぎ
steps.action_en: Turn the dial to お急ぎ
steps.narration_native: Next, choose the program. Turn the big round dial in the middle so the blue line points to お急ぎ at the upper right — that's quick wash.
steps.narration_en: Next, choose the program. Turn the big round dial in the middle so the blue line points to お急ぎ at the upper right — that's quick wash.

steps.action_native: Press 脱水 to set the spin
steps.action_en: Press 脱水 to set the spin
steps.narration_native: If your clothes are heavy, press the white 脱水 button at the top right a few times for a stronger spin. For light clothes you can skip this.
steps.narration_en: If your clothes are heavy, press the white 脱水 button at the top right a few times for a stronger spin. For light clothes you can skip this.

steps.narration_native: Finally, press the big blue button at the bottom right labelled スタート. You'll hear a beep and the wash begins.
steps.narration_en: Finally, press the big blue button at the bottom right labelled スタート. You'll hear a beep and the wash begins.

tips.native: Quick wash saves time for small loads; use a stronger spin for heavy clothes.
tips.en: Quick wash saves time for small loads; use a stronger spin for heavy clothes.

warnings.native: Don't open the lid or reach inside while the drum is moving.
warnings.en: Don't open the lid or reach inside while the drum is moving.

closing_native: That's it — the machine is running and will finish in about 38 minutes. Ask me anything!
closing_en: That's it — the machine is running and will finish in about 38 minutes. Ask me anything!
